response.overview: Like Hou Yu, the fisherman's father, Hou Xiaochuan, who was born in a seaside town in the late 1980s, also had a dream of becoming a painter. The stone carvings by the sea were his first works and the origin of his dream. But when he becomes inexplicably involved in a struggle with teenage gangsters, his painting is destroyed. People in the small border town once grew up together, and the relationship between Hou Xiaochuan and the young gangsters today is just like the situation of the young Hou Yu 30 years ago. But his father used to bear it all the time, fearing the consequences of rebellion, and was still treated like an ant in the drinking game as an adult. Now Hou Xiaochuan does not want to repeat his father's mistakes. He wants to let those domineering people know that the so-called consequences should be borne by them.
response.title: No Worries
